description: Source code for managing MIME type icon mappings, including data structures and functions for reading icon info from files, creating and freeing icon lists, and comparing entries.

classes.name: XdgIcon
classes.description: Data structure representing a MIME type and its associated icon name.

classes.name: XdgIconList
classes.description: Data structure for a list of XdgIcon entries, including number of icons.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_icon_list_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new XdgIconList.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_icon_list_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an XdgIconList and its contents.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_icon_read_from_file
methods.description: Reads icon mappings from a specified file into an XdgIconList.
